label: Executing the algorithm
subgoals: Number the operations element by element and address by address
Compute the global index from the earlier elements and the address position
Simulate writes and compare each read with its expected value

label: Cell faults
subgoals: Fail a stuck-at cell at the first read expecting the opposite value
Block the forbidden transition of a transition-fault cell on write
Catch the stuck cell with the next read of that address

label: Coupling faults and order
subgoals: Apply the coupling effect when the aggressor makes the triggering transition
Check whether the victim is read after the aggressor in that element's order
